status: proposed structural pipeline for owner approval
purpose: Turn learner needs and authoritative evidence into bounded, reviewable Crew Blueprint content without allowing research synthesis, Roadmapdev, historical branches, or registry identities to silently become publication authority.

authority.owner: final directional/publication authority where review is required
authority.qualified_external_roles: retain authority for specialist/hazardous work regardless of course completion

stages.name: INTAKE
stages.output: bounded content question + intended audience + proposed product container

stages.name: RETRIEVAL_AND_LINEAGE
requirements: identify current route and historical bodies

stages.name: TWO_LENS_RESEARCH
requirements: authority/correctness evidence appropriate to the claim
audience/employer discovery appropriate to the learner problem
stages.rule: community evidence identifies needs/friction but cannot establish technical or safety authority

stages.name: SUFFICIENCY_ANALYSIS
stages.rule: Roadmapdev may identify gaps/conflicts/priorities but cannot approve publication
stages.output: advisory sufficiency result with cited evidence IDs and unresolved questions

stages.name: DRAFT_OR_RECONCILE
requirements: reuse supported content before creating duplicates
apply Listen → Clarify → Report Back and Preserve → Verify → Report where relevant

stages.name: AUTHORITY_AND_SAFETY_GATE
checks: hazardous content remains awareness/recognition/stop-escalate unless a separately approved qualified-audience scope exists

stages.name: PRACTITIONER_AND_OWNER_REVIEW
stages.rule: Require the level of practitioner/owner review appropriate to the claim, audience, and responsibility. Historical length or polish is never approval evidence.

stages.name: LEARNER_USABILITY
checks: does it solve the stated learner problem

stages.name: PUBLICATION
stages.rule: Visible site changes follow current build-phase visible-content rule; structural/data changes remain PR-first. Update review/noindex/disclaimer state accurately.

stages.name: VALIDATION_AND_CLOSEOUT
checks: content parity where multiple presentations exist
rendered-site check appropriate to the change
stages.output: accepted current state or explicit unresolved blocker

decision_rules: A registered identity is not automatically a course.
A bibliography entry is not automatically claim support.
A newer or fuller historical branch is not automatically better/current.
A community complaint is not a universal rule.
A Roadmapdev recommendation is not Crew Blueprint canonical truth.
A learner-facing specialist topic must preserve external qualification and assignment boundaries.
Volatile employer/opportunity data should remain in Production Atlas and be linked by provenance rather than copied into static curriculum.
